City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 24, 2016 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.

3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 10, 2016 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-02-24 Item 08A Closed Session meeting minutes
2016-02-24 Item 08A Minutes - REVISED
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Appointments to the Commission for the Arts, Environmental Commission and the Traffic and Public Safety Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1. The Mayor, with approval of the City Council, make appointments to the Commission for the Arts to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2018, the Environmental Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2017, and the Traffic and Public Safety Commission to fill the two at-large representative positions with terms ending March 2019.
2016-02-24 Item 10A Commission Appointments
10B.
At Home in Encinitas - Options for the final phases of the public engagement process to obtain final public input, preparing the ballot proposition, and informing the voters about the Housing Plan ballot proposition. Contact Person: Senior Planner Strong
1. Consider the information in the Agenda Report; 2. Receive and consider public testimony; and 3. Provide direction to staff.
2016-02-24 Item 10B At Home in Encinitas
10C.
Right of Entry agreement for Pacific View site improvements. Contact Persons: Deputy Mayor Shaffer and Council Member Kranz
The Subcommittee requests that the Council authorize the City Manager to execute the attached Right of Entry agreement between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Arts, Culture and Ecology Alliance in substantial form, subject to final review and approval by the City Attorney.
2016-02-24 Item 10C Pacific View Interim Agreement
10D.
2016 Legislative Program Update. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Receive the report and provide direction as appropriate.
2016-02-24 Item 10D 2016 Legislative Program Update
2016-02-24 Item 10D - Attachment Legislation List - Encinitas Referred Short Report Format 2-22-16
10E.
Planning Commission's Annual Report and Work Plan. Contact Persons: Planning Commissioners Boerner Horvath and O'Grady.
1. Receive the Planning Commission's Annual Report and Work Plan; and 2. Provide direction to the City Manager, as desired by the Council.
2016-02-24 Item 10E Planning Commission Annual Report and Work Plan
10F.
Chesterfield Drive Rail Crossing Improvements. Contact Person: Public Works Director Pruim
1. Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute any necessary amendments to an existing agreement with HDR Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $47,508, plus 10% contingencies, to develop plans, specifications, and construction documents for the construction of Supplemental Safety Measures at Chesterfield Drive, not to exceed a total amount of $52,259; and 2. Adopt Resolution 2016-25, authorizing the additional appropriation of General Funds in the amount of $52,259 to the Montgomery Avenue At-Grade Pedestrian Rail Crossing Project (CS16E).
2016-02-24 Item 10F Chesterfield Dr. Rail Crossing Improvements
10G.
Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project. Contact Person: Program Administrator Weldon
1. Receive Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project Feasibility Study; 2. Authorize staff to apply for additional $322,000 in grant funding through the California State Coastal Conservancy for the preparation of construction documents and public outreach; and 3. Authorize the Mayor to sign a letter of support for the California State Coastal Conservancy's grant application for $2,195,932 for construction of the Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project.
2016-02-24 Item 10G Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project
10H.
Report from Subcommittee on Becoming a Welcoming Community. Contact Persons: Deputy Mayor Shaffer and Council Member Kranz
Receive and review report from the Welcoming Community Subcommittee and give direction on recommendations.
2016-02-24 Item 10H Report from Subcommittee on Becoming a Welcoming Community

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
